title: What have you been working on?

history.content: What have you been working on?

I've been looking into what I've been working on. I've recently been modifying some of my tools, specifically `ai_assistant.custom_tools.conversational_tools.request_user_clarification` and `ai_assistant.custom_tools.knowledge_tools.recall_facts`. I also attempted to modify some tools related to proposing tool modifications, but those attempts failed because the code generated wasn't a valid function definition. I've also recently interacted with files like `ai_response_generator.py`, `twilio_text_tool.py`, `weather_tool.py`, and `reminder_scheduler.py`.
You've been busy. How many of them were successful

I checked my recent activity. It looks like I've been working on modifying some tools. Of the last four tasks, two code modification tasks were completed successfully, but two attempts to propose tool modifications failed pre-review due to errors in the code generation.
Well if they failed let's work on them and see if we can't get them fixed

Okay, I checked the system status and found a couple of tool modification attempts that failed because the new code wasn't a valid function definition. I also found one successful code modification. To help me address the failed ones, can you please specify the ID of the failed suggestion you'd like me to work on? I didn't find any denied suggestions.
if they failed, can we fix them?
